title: Northbeam TechWorks Bench and Field Diagnostic Charge Schedule
content:
A diagnosis is charged for in its own right. This schedule of the Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair service point records the charge each TechWorks service makes for diagnosing a fault before any repair is agreed, and whether that charge is credited against the repair when the customer goes ahead.

| TechWorks service | Diagnostic charge, USD | Credited against the repair when the customer goes ahead |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | 39.00 | yes |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | 79.00 | yes |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | 99.00 | yes |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | 89.00 | yes |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | 125.00 | yes |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | 0.00 | yes |

### Reading the schedule

The charge rises with the service: 39.00 USD at the store counter, 79.00 USD on a standard home installation, 89.00 USD on an appliance installation, 99.00 USD on a calibration and 125.00 USD on a business deployment. TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual makes no diagnostic charge at all, its figure standing at 0.00.

All six TechWorks services credit the diagnostic charge against the repair where the customer goes ahead with it; no service of this product treats the diagnosis as a charge kept aside from the repair.
